q: The ability to upgrade Ava's accumulator to Ava's alerter.
tx:
If the player's Ranged level is less than 50 upon completion of the quest, Ava's attractor will be obtained. Then Ava's accumulator can be bought from Ava, for 75 steel arrows and 999 coins. You can also choose to upgrade the old Ava's attractor, which will still cost 75 steel arrows, but will take the old device instead of 999 coins. Multiple devices may be possessed at the same time.
Reclaiming the accumulator requires 999 coins to reclaim an attractor and an additional 75 steel arrows to convert it into an accumulator.
Players may return to Ava in Draynor Manor and tell her, "I seem to need a new device." She replies that the player is lucky that the attractors/accumulators return to Ava when lost, but it will cost them 999 coins to cover her expenses in refurbishing it.
Once the fee is paid, players receive Ava's attractor. To upgrade the attractor into an accumulator, players have to tell her: "I'd like to upgrade my device, please." For this, Ava asks for 75 steel arrows. If you didn't bring 75 steel arrows with you, you can simply purchase them from Ava. Assuming the arrows are purchased from Ava, the cost per accumulator is 4449 coins.
sc: Additionally, it is statistically a very strong early- to mid-game cape for ranged, being a step behind the Capes of Accomplishment and equivalent to the Cape of legends in damage bonus but obtainable significantly earlier than either of those options.

tx:
While the ordinary gem bag holds 100 gems total and doesn't include dragonstone, the gem bag (upgraded) holds 100 each of the eight types, including opal, jade, red topaz and dragonstone, for a total capacity of 800 gems.
The upgraded version is available to members only, which means members will no longer be able to use or retrieve gems from it after their subscription ends. Gem bags can also only be upgraded when empty.
If the player has more gems than the bag can hold, excess gems can be brought to a higher level by transmuting.
The upgraded gem bag can be emptied directly into a player's bank, while the bank interface is open, by right-clicking the bag in the backpack section of the bank interface, and selecting the "Empty" option. This removes the need for players to first empty the bag of gems before opening the bank interface, then bank the gems themselves manually. Doing so does not remove the gem bag from the player's inventory.
sc: The upgraded gem bag can be purchased for 20,000 Dungeoneering tokens from the Rewards Trader if the player has an empty ordinary gem bag in their inventory as well as level 45 Crafting and level 35 Dungeoneering.
If the player dies with the upgraded gem bag and loses it, the bag and the upgrade can be purchased back from the Rewards Trader, and all the gems previously stored in the bag will be inside.
